top_module.name: domino_automotive_aero_gateway
top_module.description: Top-level active-aerodynamics controller gateway that receives geometry and flow-condition inputs, issues model requests, validates model responses, computes a bounded actuator command, and enforces safety fallback and fault-latch behavior.
top_module.functionality: Implements the complete safety-oriented DoMINO Automotive Aero request/response gateway. The module accepts vehicle geometry descriptors and flow conditions through explicit handshake and validity signals, generates model request transactions with monotonically increasing sequence_id and captured timestamp, forwards all request metadata needed by the external model runtime, accepts model responses, validates them against the stored request context, checks response age against timeout_threshold_cycles, checks stream_velocity_mps against the 20 to 55 m/s operating envelope, rejects stale or malformed responses, and only emits actuator_command when the response is valid and fresh or when deterministic fallback is active. The module latches faults in FAULT_LATCH until clear_fault or reset according to integration policy. It provides status outputs for model_online, timeout, stale_reject, fallback_active, fault_latched, and last_sequence_id, plus readback of the current FSM state and the most recent accepted response metadata.
responsibilities: Sample and register all incoming request and response-related inputs in the single clock domain.
Assign monotonically increasing sequence_id values to accepted requests.
Capture request timestamp on acceptance and compute response age in cycles or equivalent registered timebase.
Detect mismatched sequence_id, missing fields, invalid framing, out-of-range stream velocity, timeout exceedance, and communication errors.
Block stale or invalid model commands from the actuator path.
Drive safe_state during fallback and assert fallback_active.
Latch faults in FAULT_LATCH until clear_fault or reset.
Register all outputs except the internal combinational clamp stage between registered stages.
Keep actuator_command bounded by cmd_min and cmd_max.
Expose model request and response metadata for diagnostics and integration.
Maintain deterministic behavior independent of external software scheduling.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset_n assertion, initialize to IDLE with safe fallback output active, deassert req_valid and actuator_command_valid, clear counters and metadata registers, set last_sequence_id to zero, set model_online low until observed or qualified by input, and clear transient status flags. fault_latched is cleared on reset unless integration policy chooses otherwise; this contract permits reset-clear behavior. All registered outputs assume deterministic safe values immediately after reset deassertion and remain so until enabled and a valid request/response sequence is processed.
behavior_rules: FSM states shall be IDLE, REQUEST_SENT, WAIT_RESPONSE, VALIDATE_RESPONSE, COMPUTE_CONTROL, APPLY_CLAMP, Fallback, and FAULT_LATCH, encoded in fsm_state.
A request may be accepted only when enable is high, vehicle_geometry_valid and flow_conditions_valid are high, and the module is not fault latched or otherwise blocked.
Each accepted request shall increment last_sequence_id monotonically and drive req_sequence_id with the new value.
req_timestamp shall capture the accepted request time reference at request acceptance.
The module shall forward geometry descriptor fields and flow-condition inputs exactly as received, without physical interpretation or geometry parsing.

A response is valid only if rsp_valid and rsp_frame_valid are asserted, rsp_sequence_id matches the stored sequence_id, all mandatory response fields are present, and stream_velocity_mps is within 20 to 55 m/s.
Any response age greater than timeout_threshold_cycles shall be treated as invalid and shall assert timeout.
Any invalid, missing, stale, malformed, out-of-range, or mismatched response shall be rejected and shall not reach actuator_command.
stale_reject shall assert whenever a response is blocked due to sequence mismatch, age exceedance, or invalid freshness qualification.
Fallback shall drive actuator_command to safe_state and assert fallback_active; actuator_command_valid shall only assert in fallback or in validated nominal control.
The clamp stage shall implement cmd_out = min(max(cmd_in, cmd_min), cmd_max) using combinational logic between registered stages only.
actuator_command shall never exceed cmd_min/cmd_max bounds.
fault_latched shall assert on fault conditions and persist until clear_fault is asserted or reset is applied.
model_online shall reflect input qualification of the external model runtime and shall be registered.
No unvalidated model data may be applied to the actuator output.
All outputs shall be registered except the pure clamp function and associated next-state combinational logic.
The design shall remain deterministic under all legal input conditions and shall not depend on external software scheduling for safety outcomes.
If latency_budget_cycles is exceeded for a pending response, the controller shall force fallback or fault handling within one control cycle or less subject to the budget.
Readback metadata shall reflect the most recently accepted and validated response only.

modules.name: domino_request_gateway
modules.description: Request-side transaction manager for the external DoMINO Automotive Aero runtime. Captures request metadata, assigns sequence identifiers, stamps timestamps, and emits a clean request transaction only when the request is accepted by the model interface.
modules.functionality: Generates request transactions for the external model runtime. On accepted request, captures geometry and flow descriptors, increments the monotonically increasing sequence counter, captures timestamp, and emits a fully tagged request bundle. Does not interpret geometry physically. Provides only transport and semantic request metadata required by downstream model runtime integration.
responsibilities: Assign monotonic sequence identifiers.
Capture and hold the request timestamp.
Forward all request metadata fields explicitly.
Respect request acceptance and req_ready qualification.
Provide last_sequence_id for diagnostics and downstream safety logic.
modules.reset_behavior: Clear request outputs, sequence counter, and timestamp state. Hold req_valid low and last_sequence_id at zero until a request is accepted after reset.
behavior_rules: Request emission shall be synchronous and deterministic.
Sequence IDs shall increase monotonically on each accepted request.
Timestamp capture shall occur on the acceptance event.
All request metadata fields shall be forwarded without physical evaluation.
No geometry parsing or physics calculation shall occur in this module.
If enable is low, no request shall be emitted.

modules.name: domino_response_validator
modules.description: Response-side safety validator for external DoMINO model outputs. Checks response framing, sequence matching, freshness, timeout, envelope, and field completeness, and emits validated response metadata only when a response is safe to consume.
modules.functionality: Validates model responses against the stored request context and operating envelope. Accepts only framed, complete, fresh, and sequence-matched responses. Rejects stale, mismatched, malformed, missing-field, timeout-exceeded, or out-of-envelope responses. Produces registered accepted-response metadata for control generation and diagnostic readback.
responsibilities: Detect response framing validity.
Compare response sequence_id against the stored request sequence_id.
Evaluate response age against timeout_threshold_cycles.
Check stream_velocity_mps against the 20 to 55 m/s envelope.
Preserve validated response metadata for downstream control.
Generate freshness, timeout, stale_reject, and model_online status outputs.
modules.reset_behavior: Clear validation state and all accepted-response metadata. Deassert response_validated, stale_reject, timeout, out_of_range, and model_online until qualified by incoming status.
behavior_rules: A response is valid only when framing, sequence, and freshness conditions are simultaneously satisfied.
Any mismatch or missing field shall be treated as invalid.
Any response exceeding timeout_threshold_cycles shall assert timeout and be rejected.
Any stream_velocity_mps outside 20 to 55 m/s shall assert out_of_range and force rejection or fallback propagation.
Validated response metadata shall be held stable until superseded by a newer validated response.
No unvalidated response field shall be forwarded as accepted metadata.
model_online shall reflect qualification of the model runtime input and validation status.
Latency budget violations shall force safety handling within one control cycle or less.

modules.name: domino_control_safety_fsm
modules.description: Control synthesis and safety state machine. Consumes validated aerodynamic outputs, computes a bounded actuator command, applies clamp logic, handles fallback and fault latch behavior, and blocks stale or invalid model data from reaching the actuator output.
modules.functionality: Implements the state machine IDLE, REQUEST_SENT, WAIT_RESPONSE, VALIDATE_RESPONSE, COMPUTE_CONTROL, APPLY_CLAMP, Fallback, and FAULT_LATCH. Computes the nominal control command from validated aerodynamic outputs using fixed-point or integer mapping, applies a pure combinational clamp against cmd_min and cmd_max, and selects safe_state whenever fallback or fault handling is required. Ensures no stale or invalid model data reaches actuator_command.
responsibilities: Implement the safety FSM and its registered state transitions.
Translate validated aerodynamic outputs into a control candidate.
Apply pure combinational clamp logic between registered stages.
Assert fallback_active when entering safe fallback mode.
Latch faults until clear_fault or reset.
Emit actuator_command only when allowed by validation or fallback rules.
modules.reset_behavior: Enter IDLE and drive safe fallback output. Clear actuator command registers, deassert actuator_command_valid, clear fallback_active and fault_latched state unless reset policy requires retention, and initialize FSM state deterministically.
behavior_rules: On request acceptance, transition through REQUEST_SENT then WAIT_RESPONSE.
On valid response, transition through VALIDATE_RESPONSE then COMPUTE_CONTROL then APPLY_CLAMP.
On validation failure, timeout, comm error, or envelope violation, transition to Fallback.
Fallback shall drive safe_state deterministically and assert fallback_active.
Faults shall latch in FAULT_LATCH until clear_fault or reset.
The clamp stage shall compute min(max(cmd_in, cmd_min), cmd_max).
No unvalidated or stale data may be driven to actuator_command.
actuator_command_valid shall assert only for validated fresh responses or explicit fallback selection.
The FSM state output shall be registered and readable for diagnostics.
The control path shall be deterministic and synthesizable in standard-cell ASIC flow.
